overviewHtml:
Chitwan national park is the first national park of Nepal which is situated in the mid southern plain land of Nepal covering an area of 932 sq. km. It was established in 1973 and enlisted in UNESCO world heritage site in 1984. Chitwan national park is the best destination for .jungle safari in Nepal, Chitwan national park is famous for the endangered one horned rhino royal Bengal tiger, and Gharial. In this safari you can see the various types of wild birds and animals.

While exploring the Chitwan national park you can encounter wild animal like hog deer, sloth deer, common leopard, chital, barking deer, wild dog, palm civet, wild buffalo, Royal Bengal tiger etc. In this safari you can also visit the nearby ethnic villages of the Tharu and Chepang. In Chepang village you can visit the Chepang museum and get insight into their history, culture, lifestyle, religion etc. you can explore the Chitwan national park in three different ways: on the back of the elephant, by jeep and on the foot. The jungle safari in Chitwan national park which is rich in flora and fauna as well as wild life provides you the wilderness experience to the tourists. There you can see rare one horn rhino face to face. You can combine this jungle safari with canoeing on the Narayani/ Sapta Gandaki River and Rapti River. In this our package you can visit the Tharu and Chepang village- the ethnic groups of Nepal around the national park and get insight into their lifestyle, culture and religion. You can combine the Chitwan National park Jungle safari with the Lumbini or Pokhara tour.
